mechanism.pointer_load_count_caveat: The static 4-to-2 count also reflects different loop peeling. Native code still loads the two view pointers in the loop; do not interpret this count as proof of loop-invariant load hoisting. Confirmed savings include getter calls and surrounding spills/tag conversions.

candidate_profile.caveat: Time-budget benchmarks execute different amounts of work; sample fractions are not a fixed-work speedup measurement.

validation.selection: ArrayBuffer, DataView, resizable/growable buffers, Wasm buffer growth; --run-skipped --variants=default
validation.additional_new_coverage: Foreign getter exception realm passed after the 22-script selection.
validation.build: Release x64, sandbox and pointer compression enabled; no full multi-platform or sanitizer validation.

matched_diagnostic_capture.note: Trace-turbo disables concurrent recompilation; use this matched capture for direct code-size comparison. The earlier untraced sampling capture also emitted a 1172-byte later version of the baseline function.
